Overview

Patna is a city in Bihar with a population of 2,500,000. The capital of Bihar, one of the world’s oldest continuously inhabited cities, with a rich history spanning over two millennia. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
